obligations.note: The new AppLog.debug method calls the existing _emit path, which masks fields with npi.mask before writing. The new test asserts a raw account number is absent from a debug line while the message is present, and the registered LOG-1 sample control test plus the existing mask tests passed unskipped on the head commit.

The change names ticket CHG-24612, which change manager Grace Kim approved on 2026-10-06 before review. Its components, payments.logging and payments.tests, match logs.py and tests/test_log_debug.py in the payments component map.
Mara Costa, a payments change approver and not the author Sofia Santos, approved a code review of the head commit.
The change is a single commit, 43ce6f2ed158cf93ec349a6857f8f602e8e1ce9d, and both the code review and the security review name that commit.

records/ci/run.json records a successful payments suite on the head commit, and the JUnit report shows 173 tests with no failures, errors, or skips, including tests/controls/test_logging_control.py::test_sampled_flows_do_not_log_npi.
logs.py is security-sensitive. Ines Halvorsen, a security reviewer and not the author, approved a security review of the same head commit.

summary: The change adds a debug level on payments AppLog that uses the same masked emit path as info, warning, and error. Ticket, independent code review, security review, and a green full suite on the final commit are all in order, and the diff does not touch protected control paths or an emergency ticket. Debug output of an NPI account number is covered by the new passing test and by the registered logging control test.
